headings.usage: Use Bricolage Grotesque for all H1-H4 headings. Keep letter-spacing tight (tracking-tight) to enhance the premium, structural agency feel. Never center-align hero headings; prefer left-alignment for a bold editorial look.

body.usage: Use Manrope for all body copy, descriptions, and metadata. Use loose line-height (leading-relaxed) for readability.

background.description: A deep obsidian/midnight tone. NOT pure black (#000000). Use subtle radial gradient spotlights to create depth behind the glass cards.

page_background_treatment.css: background-color: #07070A; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.03), transparent 25%), radial-gradient(circle at 85% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.02), transparent 25%);
page_background_treatment.instructions: Create a deep, moody environment. Add a noise/grain texture overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire page to kill the digital flatness and give it a premium studio feel.

glassmorphism_recipe.container_classes: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/[0.08] shadow-[0_8px_32px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)] transition-all duration-300
glassmorphism_recipe.accent_integration: Each card should feature a subtle radial gradient blob in the background of the card (e.g., top right corner) using its specific tool_accent color. This creates distinctiveness while maintaining the cohesive glass system.

layout_composition.nav: Minimal. Fixed to top, z-50. Glassmorphism enabled (bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/5). Left: 'IT Tools by [Name/Brand]'. Right: Anchor link to '#tools'.
layout_composition.hero: Massive left-aligned typography. Include a clear value proposition: 'Built on 12 years of IT operations experience.' Add an optical 'scroll down' indicator. Use wide padding (py-32).
layout_composition.toolkit_grid: Grid layout. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8. Padding py-24. Each card must be a direct child. Give the grid generous spacing to let the glass breathe.
layout_composition.footer: Minimal. py-16 border-t border-white/10. Copyright and a subtle sign-off. Monochrome text.

tool_card.structure: 1. Overline (Accent color, Tool Category), 2. Title (H3), 3. Description (Manrope, 2-3 lines), 4. Price Tag ($29), 5. 'Get Tool' Button.
tool_card.button_style: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Solid background matching the tool's accent color (with hover state tightening opacity or brightness). Ensure text on the button is accessible (dark text on bright accents, light text on dark accents).
tool_card.gumroad_integration: Wrap the buy button or card entirely in an <a> tag pointing to the Gumroad URL. Ensure it has the class 'gumroad-button' if required by the already loaded script, or just standard href.

micro_interactions.cards: Smooth transform translateY on hover. Subtle increase in border opacity.
micro_interactions.buttons: Scale up slightly (scale-105) on hover or press.
micro_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is already installed. Ensure anchor links smoothly glide to the sections.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: No pure #000 backgrounds. Use the rich tinted dark theme.
Do not use transparent headers without blur.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Avoid centering large paragraphs of text.
Respect contrast ratios, especially text over the glass cards. If text is hard to read, darken the background behind it slightly.
Use framer-motion for simple staggered entrance animations when the grid scrolls into view.
instructions_to_main_agent: Use purely React/Tailwind/Framer Motion. Since it's a landing page without complex state, avoid heavy Shadcn components for layout. Build the tool cards using the glassmorphism recipe. Make sure each of the 6 tools uses its designated accent color for the inner glow/border highlight and CTA button to make it distinct. The Gumroad script is already in index.html, so you only need to use standard <a> tags with the Gumroad href.
